title: Itemable Bountys
description: Allows players to place item bounties on other players. When a player with a bounty is killed, the killer receives the bounty items. Includes leaderboards for top targets and top bounty hunters, offline player support, and full customization.
body:
Itemable Bountys lets players place item-based bounties on other players. When a player with a bounty is killed, the killer receives the items stored in the bounty.

The plugin includes a full bounty system with leaderboards for top targets and top bounty hunters. It supports offline players, allowing bounties to be placed even if the target is not currently online.

All features are fully configurable, including messages, notify feature, and more, making it suitable for survival, PvP, SMP servers.
